{{Quote|But, Mel, look. If these are authentic Expansionist Era Hutt ''kucha''-sculpts, they could be worth a ''fortune''!|[[Caira]]|<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>}}
'''''Kucha''-sculpts''{{'}} were a form of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] bas-relief artwork, produced during the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]]. The walls of [[Terman Station]] were covered in ''kucha''-sculpts, a discovery that the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], [[Caira]], was amazed at.<ref name="SSR" />
